<!-- T123 · Revolut — One Market First · block 2 of 3: game engine · generated by node scripts/build.mjs -->
<script>
(() => {
"use strict";

const shared = window.__omfModules || {};
if (!shared.hash || !shared.tuning || !shared.scenario) {
  const notice = document.querySelector('#one-market-first [data-ui="notice"]');
  if (notice) {
    notice.textContent = "A game block is missing. Paste the three blocks in order: 1 HTML, styles and data, 2 game engine, 3 game interface.";
    notice.hidden = false;
  }
  return;
}
const __omf_hash = shared.hash;
const __omf_tuning = shared.tuning;
const __omf_scenario = shared.scenario;

// src/rules.mjs
const __omf_rules = (() => {
const { CONFIG, MARKETS, ROUNDS, WORKSHEET, RUBRIC, BRIEF, BULLETINS, SINGAPORE, PROBLEMS } = __omf_scenario;
const { hash32 } = __omf_hash;
const { tuning, retestDelta } = __omf_tuning;
const SCHEDULE = [
  [-20, 0, "SETUP", "Team assignments, Board brief and practice"],
  [0, 16, "R1", "Customer and CAGE"],
  [16, 32, "R2", "Customer evidence"],
  [32, 50, "R3", "Entry route and Uppsala"],
  [50, 60, "R4", "Readiness and checkpoint"],
  [60, 70, "BREAK", "Break"],
  [70, 84, "R5", "Competitor response"],
  [84, 104, "R6", "Emergency · bulletin B at +8 minutes"],
  [104, 119, "R7", "Recommendation"],
  [119, 130, "PREP", "Board Brief preparation"],
  [130, 146, "PITCH", "Four pitches · 3 minutes and 1 question each"],
  [146, 150, "DEBRIEF", "Funding decision and debrief"]
].map(([from, to, id, label]) => ({from, to, id, label}));

const MINUTE = 60_000;
const TEAMS = [1, 2, 3, 4];
const PRICE = {
  interview: 2, prototype: 3, pilot: 2, alliance: 3, acquisition: 5,
  verify: 2, narrow: 1, broaden: 2, diligence: 1, targeted: 1,
  fullOne: 3, fullTwo: 4
};
// Base price plus the market's own adjustment (see tuning.mjs). Never below zero.
function price(marketId, key) {
  return Math.max(0, PRICE[key] + (tuning().markets[marketId]?.price?.[key] ?? 0));
}

// The problem a profile's emergency note is about (the first one when it is about two).
function problemFor(marketId, profileKey) {
  return MARKETS[marketId].profiles[profileKey].problems[0];
}

const ROUTES = { pilot: "Pilot with local provider", alliance: "Contractual alliance", acquisition: "Prepare an acquisition", planning: "Preparation without a selected route" };
const OUTCOMES = {
  pilot2: ["Conditional pilot with two cohorts", "Request approval for two cohorts subject to confirmed permissions, provider readiness for each channel and the named launch condition. Name what you would do if one cohort misses its threshold."],
  pilot: ["Conditional first pilot", "Request approval for one cohort subject to confirmed permissions, provider readiness and the named launch condition. Add a second cohort only if it survived the correction and the first cohort meets your threshold."],
  deal: ["Conditional acquisition work", "Request continued deal work against the named closing condition. Closing, permissions, operational readiness and a separate launch decision remain ahead."],
  retest: ["Fund a supervised test", "Request one mock cohort without live funds or public launch. Return to the Board with proof against your stated milestone."],
  defer: ["Fund preparation and defer", "Request a specific preparation step. Name the unresolved obstacle, evidence required and review date."]
};

// Fingerprint of everything a team reads or is charged for. Saves remember it, so a page that was
// republished with different content can warn instead of silently showing other results.
// Changes to the rule logic itself are covered by CONFIG.version.
const tuned = tuning();
const CONTENT_ID = hash32(JSON.stringify([MARKETS, ROUNDS, PROBLEMS, BULLETINS, WORKSHEET, RUBRIC, BRIEF, SINGAPORE, PRICE, SCHEDULE, OUTCOMES, CONFIG.budget,
  tuned.name, tuned.gameShare, tuned.askPilotTwo, tuned.scoring, tuned.markets, tuned.randomness.retestSpread]));

function contentMismatch(record) {
  return !!record?.content && record.content !== CONTENT_ID;
}

function permutations(items) {
  if (items.length === 1) return [items];
  return items.flatMap((item, index) =>
    permutations(items.filter((_, rest) => rest !== index)).map(rest => [item, ...rest]));
}

const assignments = permutations(Object.keys(MARKETS));

function makeRoom(start, assignmentIndex, suffix) {
  return "OMF-" + Math.floor(start / MINUTE).toString(36).toUpperCase() + "-" +
    assignmentIndex.toString(36).toUpperCase() + suffix.toUpperCase();
}

function roomParts(value) {
  return /^OMF-([A-Z0-9]{5,7})-([0-9A-N])([A-Z0-9]{3})$/.exec(String(value).trim().toUpperCase());
}

function roomStart(value) {
  const match = roomParts(value);
  if (!match) return null;
  const start = parseInt(match[1], 36) * MINUTE;
  return start >= Date.UTC(2025, 0, 1) && start <= Date.UTC(2100, 0, 1) ? start : null;
}

function marketForTable(room, team) {
  const match = roomParts(room);
  return match ? assignments[parseInt(match[2], 36)]?.[team - 1] : null;
}

function phaseAt(room, now) {
  const minute = (now - roomStart(room)) / MINUTE;
  const phase = SCHEDULE.find(item => minute >= item.from && minute < item.to);
  return phase ? {...phase, minute, bulletinB: phase.id === "R6" && minute >= 92} :
    {id: minute < 0 ? "SETUP" : "END", minute, to: minute < 0 ? 0 : null, bulletinB: false};
}

function endOfRound(room, id) {
  return roomStart(room) + SCHEDULE.find(phase => phase.id === id).to * MINUTE;
}

function startOfRound(room, id) {
  return roomStart(room) + SCHEDULE.find(phase => phase.id === id).from * MINUTE;
}

function initialProgress() {
  return {
    credits: CONFIG.budget, profile: null, research: null, route: null, verified: false, narrow: false,
    cohorts: 1, diligence: false, incident: null, launchEvidence: false, result: null
  };
}

function option(id, cost, label, description, blocked = "") {
  return {id, cost, label, description, blocked};
}

function optionsFor(id, state, marketId) {
  const market = MARKETS[marketId];
  const profile = market.profiles[state.profile];
  let options;
  switch (id) {
    case "R1":
      options = Object.entries(market.profiles).map(([key, item]) => option(key, 0, item.name, item.journey));
      break;
    case "R2":
      options = [
        option("desk", 0, "Keep the base dossier", "Use the market facts and first customer signal. Preserve credits for entry or the emergency."),
        option("interview", price(marketId, "interview"), "Buy an interview follow-up", "Get evidence about why this segment might switch. This measures stated preferences."),
        option("prototype", price(marketId, "prototype"), "Test the mock journey", "Get a result on how users interpret the quote, status or support screen. No money moves.")
      ];
      break;
    case "R3":
      options = [
        option("pilot", price(marketId, "pilot"), ROUTES.pilot, "Scope one use case, in one city, with one cohort. The local provider handles any authorized activity after permission and readiness checks."),
        option("alliance", price(marketId, "alliance"), ROUTES.alliance, "Prepare a co-branded offer and define distribution and support responsibilities. In R5 you may add a second cohort if you can afford it."),
        option("acquisition", price(marketId, "acquisition"), ROUTES.acquisition, "Screen the target, plan diligence and integration. The deeper transaction check in R5 is needed for a deal mandate at the Board.")
      ];
      break;
    case "R4":
      options = [
        option("reserve", 0, "Keep a reserve", "Record a permission or contract dependency. Pay the standard rates if you later need to issue and test a correction."),
        option("verify", price(marketId, "verify"), "Verify readiness", "Buy a scoped finding and pre-agreed correction wording. An approved one-channel correction is free. A full correction and retest costs one credit less.")
      ];
      break;
    case "R5":
      options = [
        option("keep", 0, "Keep your proposition", "Keep the use case and one channel. Defend a claim the competitor still leaves open."),
        option("narrow", price(marketId, "narrow"), "Narrow and test the proposition", "Keep the R1 profile. Limit the corridor, subgroup or promise and unlock a five-person mock result. You may reuse the tested scope for a targeted correction."),
        option("broaden", price(marketId, "broaden"), "Add a second cohort and channel", "Reach a second group in the same city and segment. Full correction costs more when two channels are exposed.",
          state.route === "alliance" ? "" : "Available on the alliance route."),
        option("diligence", price(marketId, "diligence"), "Investigate the deal’s main risk", "Get a target-specific finding and a closing condition. This qualifies you to request deal work once outreach has been corrected.",
          state.route === "acquisition" ? "" : "Available on the acquisition route.")
      ];
      break;
    case "R6":
      options = [
        option("hold", 0, "Hold outreach", "Publish a holding statement and document the incident. The next ask can fund preparation and a later review."),
        option("targeted", state.verified ? 0 : price(marketId, "targeted"), "Correct one channel", "Pick the problem you are correcting and pause all uncorrected messages. Keep one cohort. If you name what your customers actually misunderstood, readiness verification or the narrow mock test lets you validate the correction in that cohort."),
        option("full", (state.cohorts === 2 ? price(marketId, "fullTwo") : price(marketId, "fullOne")) - Number(state.verified),
          "Correct every channel and retest", "Correct all planned channels and run a mock comprehension check with 20 people per cohort. Each cohort needs at least 16 correct responses. A prior prototype, preparation of approved wording or a narrowed test can improve the result. Real tests vary: a result can land one answer above or below the expectation.")
      ];
      break;
    case "R7": {
      const pilotBlock = !["pilot", "alliance"].includes(state.route) ? "Requires a pilot or alliance route." :
        state.launchEvidence ? "" : "Requires evidence that users understood the corrected offer.";
      const dealBlock = state.route !== "acquisition" ? "Requires the acquisition route." :
        !state.diligence ? "Requires the R5 deal-risk check." :
        state.incident === "hold" ? "Requires at least a targeted public correction in R6." : "";
      const pilotTwoBlock = state.route !== "alliance" ? "Requires the alliance route." :
        state.cohorts !== 2 ? "Requires two cohorts from the second-channel step." :
        state.launchEvidence ? "" : "Requires evidence that users in both cohorts understood the corrected offer.";
      options = [
        ...(tuning().askPilotTwo ? [option("pilot2", 0, "Request conditional approval for a pilot with two cohorts",
          "The Board can approve both cohorts. Each cohort still depends on the stated launch conditions.", pilotTwoBlock)] : []),
        option("pilot", 0, "Request conditional approval for a pilot", "The Board can approve the next step. Live activity still depends on the stated launch conditions.", pilotBlock),
        option("deal", 0, "Request a conditional mandate for deal work", "Request deeper diligence or negotiation against a specific closing condition. A go-live decision follows separately.", dealBlock),
        option("retest", 0, "Request one revised mock test", "Use one cohort with no live funds. Return to the Board before seeking pilot approval.",
          state.incident === "hold" ? "Outreach is on hold. Request preparation and a review instead." : ""),
        option("defer", 0, "Defer live activity and fund preparation", "Request one preparatory step and set a condition and a date for returning to the Board.")
      ];
      break;
    }
    default: throw new Error("Unknown round.");
  }

  return options.map(item => ({
    ...item,
    blocked: item.blocked || (item.cost > state.credits ? "Needs " + item.cost + " credits. You have " + state.credits + "." : "")
  }));
}

function fallbackFor(round, state, marketId) {
  if (round.id === "R3") return option("planning", 0, ROUTES.planning, "Continue with one mock cohort. There is no live entry route to present.");
  return optionsFor(round.id, state, marketId).find(item => item.id === round.fallback);
}

function dealClause(route) {
  return {
    pilot: "Check that the local provider is ready and permitted to run the specified activity. The provider must approve claims about fees and availability.",
    alliance: "Set the exact approval responsibility in the draft agreement. Both firms must clear a co-branded public offer before release.",
    acquisition: "Check which permissions, vendor terms and claims would survive a change of control. The target’s existing arrangements do not carry over automatically."
  }[route] || "Scope a mock test and identify a licensed provider before discussing any live activity.";
}

function pendingFact(round, state, marketId) {
  const market = MARKETS[marketId];
  const profile = market.profiles[state.profile];
  return {
    R2: profile?.signal,
    R4: dealClause(state.route),
    R5: profile?.competitor,
    R7: "The Board can fund one next step and reserve first-launch priority for that market. State exactly what it is being asked to approve."
  }[round];
}

function responseResult(state, selection, profile, marketId, record, problem) {
  if (selection === "hold") return {
    incident: "hold", launchEvidence: false, cohorts: state.cohorts,
    result: "Outreach stopped. Preserve the evidence and propose a review date."
  };
  if (selection === "targeted") {
    const loss = state.cohorts === 2 ? "The second cohort is removed. " : "";
    const label = PROBLEMS.find(item => item.id === problem)?.label.split(":")[0].toLowerCase() ?? "that";
    if (!profile.problems.includes(problem)) {
      // Naming another problem corrects something the customers were not confused about.
      return {
        cohorts: 1, incident: "targeted", launchEvidence: false,
        result: loss + "The correction addresses " + label + ", but your customers were confused about something else, so it does not reach them. " +
          "No comprehension result is available. A new test is needed before a pilot ask."
      };
    }
    const proven = state.verified || state.narrow;
    const reason = state.verified ? "The prior wording review supports a scoped follow-up." :
      state.narrow ? "The earlier narrow prototype supports a scoped follow-up." : "";
    return {
      cohorts: 1, incident: "targeted", launchEvidence: proven,
      result: loss + (proven ? reason + " Four of five mock users in the retained cohort understood the correction. The result supports a conditional proposal for that scope." :
        "One channel is corrected. No comprehension result is available yet. A new test is needed before a pilot ask.")
    };
  }
  const advantage = state.narrow ? 2 : Number(state.verified || state.research === "prototype");
  const shift = tuning().markets[marketId]?.testShift ?? 0;
  // A live room fixes the draw (room, table, round). A practice table uses its own session, so rehearsals differ.
  const seed = record.mode === "practice" ? "practice-" + record.session : record.room;
  const draw = cohort => retestDelta([seed, record.team, "R6", cohort].join("|"));
  const clamp = value => Math.min(20, Math.max(0, value));
  const firstBase = state.narrow ? 18 : state.cohorts === 2 ? 16 + advantage : 15 + advantage;
  const firstResult = clamp(firstBase + shift + draw(1));
  const counts = state.cohorts === 2 ? [firstResult, clamp(17 + shift + draw(2))] : [firstResult];
  const launchEvidence = counts.every(count => count >= 16);
  return {
    incident: "full", launchEvidence, cohorts: state.cohorts,
    result: "Full retest: " + counts.map((count, index) => "cohort " + (index + 1) + " " + count + "/20").join(", ") +
      " correctly identified the scope and corrected claim. The threshold is 16/20 in each cohort. " +
      (launchEvidence ? "The retest met the threshold. " : "The retest missed the threshold. A revised test is needed for a pilot. ") + profile.incident
  };
}

function applyChoice(state, round, selection, marketId, record, event) {
  const market = MARKETS[marketId];
  const profile = market.profiles[state.profile];
  const next = {...state, credits: state.credits - selection.cost, result: null};
  switch (round.id) {
    case "R1":
      next.profile = selection.id;
      next.result = "Selected " + market.profiles[selection.id].name + ". The dossier and later events follow this profile.";
      break;
    case "R2":
      next.research = selection.id;
      next.result = {desk: "The base dossier is your evidence. Record what you would test next.", interview: profile.interview, prototype: profile.prototype}[selection.id];
      break;
    case "R3":
      next.route = selection.id;
      next.result = market.candidates[selection.id]?.join(" · ") || selection.description;
      break;
    case "R4":
      next.verified = selection.id === "verify";
      next.result = next.verified ? "Scoped review: " + profile.review + " Use the approved template: ‘This is a concept test for [scope]. Availability, timing and fees depend on [conditions]. For questions: [approved contact].’ This supports a one-channel follow-up and lowers the cost of the full retest." :
        "Reserve retained. The open condition remains: " + dealClause(state.route);
      break;
    case "R5":
      next.narrow = selection.id === "narrow";
      next.diligence = selection.id === "diligence";
      next.cohorts = selection.id === "broaden" ? 2 : 1;
      next.result = {keep: "One cohort. The key claim still needs to stand up to the rival’s offer.", narrow: profile.narrow,
        broaden: "Two cohorts and two channels. A targeted correction retains one cohort. A full retest can keep both.", diligence: market.diligence}[selection.id];
      break;
    case "R6":
      Object.assign(next, responseResult(state, selection.id, profile, marketId, record, event?.problem));
      break;
    case "R7":
      next.result = OUTCOMES[selection.id][1];
      break;
  }
  return next;
}

// A decision needs a choice, evidence and a trade-off; correcting one channel in R6 also needs the problem.
function isDraftComplete(draft, roundId) {
  const basic = !!draft?.choice && !!draft.evidence?.trim() && !!draft.tradeoff?.trim();
  return basic && (roundId !== "R6" || draft.choice !== "targeted" || PROBLEMS.some(item => item.id === draft.problem));
}

function resolveChoice(event, round, state, marketId) {
  if (event.method === "default") {
    const fallback = fallbackFor(round, state, marketId);
    if (event.choice !== fallback.id) throw new Error("Unexpected default in " + round.id + ".");
    return fallback;
  }
  if (!["submitted", "deadline"].includes(event.method) || !isDraftComplete(event, round.id)) {
    throw new Error("Incomplete decision in " + round.id + ".");
  }
  const chosen = optionsFor(round.id, state, marketId).find(item => item.id === event.choice);
  if (!chosen || chosen.blocked) throw new Error(chosen?.blocked || "Invalid choice in " + round.id + ".");
  return chosen;
}

function replay(record) {
  let state = initialProgress();
  const path = record.history.map((event, index) => {
    const round = ROUNDS[index];
    if (!round || event.round !== round.id) throw new Error("Decisions are out of order.");
    const chosen = resolveChoice(event, round, state, record.market);
    state = applyChoice(state, round, chosen, record.market, record, event);
    return {...event, label: chosen.label, cost: chosen.cost, credits: state.credits, result: state.result, state};
  });
  return {state, path};
}

function newDecision(record, progress, round, method, now) {
  const draft = record.drafts[round.id] || {};
  const choice = method === "default" ? fallbackFor(round, progress, record.market).id : draft.choice;
  const event = {round: round.id, method, choice, at: new Date(now).toISOString(), evidence: draft.evidence || "", tradeoff: draft.tradeoff || "",
    ...(round.id === "R6" && choice === "targeted" ? {problem: draft.problem} : {})};
  if (method !== "default") resolveChoice(event, round, progress, record.market);
  return {...record, history: [...record.history, event]};
}

function settleDeadlines(record, now) {
  if (record.mode !== "live") return record;
  for (const round of ROUNDS.slice(record.history.length)) {
    const deadline = endOfRound(record.room, round.id);
    if (now < deadline) break;
    const {state} = replay(record);
    const draft = record.drafts[round.id];
    const valid = isDraftComplete(draft, round.id) && optionsFor(round.id, state, record.market).some(item => item.id === draft.choice && !item.blocked);
    record = newDecision(record, state, round, valid ? "deadline" : "default", deadline);
  }
  return record;
}

function lockRound(record, roundId, now, useDefault = false) {
  const round = ROUNDS[record.history.length];
  if (round?.id !== roundId) throw new Error("This round is already closed.");
  assertOpen(record, roundId, now);
  if (roundId === "R6" && !canReadBulletinB(record, now)) throw new Error("Wait for bulletin B before locking a response.");
  if (useDefault && record.mode === "live") throw new Error("The classroom default applies when the round closes.");
  return newDecision(record, replay(record).state, round, useDefault ? "default" : "submitted", now);
}

function canReadBulletinB(record, now) {
  return record.mode === "practice" ? record.bulletinB :
    now >= roomStart(record.room) + 92 * MINUTE;
}

function assertOpen(record, roundId, now) {
  const round = ROUNDS.find(item => item.id === roundId);
  if (!round) throw new Error("Unknown round.");
  if (record.mode === "live") {
    if (phaseAt(record.room, now).id !== roundId) throw new Error("This round is not open.");
  } else {
    const active = ROUNDS[record.history.length]?.id;
    const justLocked = record.history.at(-1)?.round;
    if (active !== roundId && justLocked !== roundId) throw new Error("This practice round is closed.");
  }
}

function updateDraft(record, roundId, field, value, now) {
  assertOpen(record, roundId, now);
  if (ROUNDS[record.history.length]?.id !== roundId) throw new Error("The decision has already been locked.");
  if (field === "choice") {
    if (roundId === "R6" && !canReadBulletinB(record, now)) throw new Error("Wait for bulletin B.");
    const selected = optionsFor(roundId, replay(record).state, record.market).find(item => item.id === value && !item.blocked);
    if (!selected) throw new Error("This choice is unavailable.");
  } else if (field === "problem") {
    if (roundId !== "R6" || !PROBLEMS.some(item => item.id === value)) throw new Error("Choose one of the listed problems.");
  } else if (field !== "evidence" && field !== "tradeoff") throw new Error("Unknown draft field.");
  const draft = {...record.drafts[roundId], [field]: value.slice(0, CONFIG.maxNote)};
  return {...record, drafts: {...record.drafts, [roundId]: draft}};
}

function updateNote(record, roundId, field, value, now) {
  assertOpen(record, roundId, now);
  if (!WORKSHEET[roundId]?.some(item => item[0] === field)) throw new Error("Unknown worksheet field.");
  return {...record, notes: {...record.notes, [roundId + "." + field]: value.slice(0, CONFIG.maxNote)}};
}

function updateBrief(record, value, now) {
  const ready = record.mode === "practice" ? record.history.length === ROUNDS.length : phaseAt(record.room, now).id === "PREP";
  if (!ready) throw new Error("The Board Brief is closed for editing.");
  return {...record, brief: value.slice(0, CONFIG.maxNote * 3)};
}

function normalizeNotes(source) {
  const notes = {};
  for (const [round, fields] of Object.entries(WORKSHEET)) {
    for (const [field] of fields) {
      const key = round + "." + field;
      if (typeof source?.[key] === "string") notes[key] = source[key].slice(0, CONFIG.maxNote);
    }
  }
  return notes;
}

function cleanText(value) {
  return typeof value === "string" ? value.slice(0, CONFIG.maxNote) : "";
}

function validateRecord(record) {
  if (record?.game !== CONFIG.game || record.version !== CONFIG.version) throw new Error("This file belongs to another game or rules version.");
  const {mode, team, market, room, history} = record;
  if (!["live", "practice"].includes(mode) || !TEAMS.includes(team) || !Object.hasOwn(MARKETS, market) ||
      (mode === "live" ? roomStart(room) === null || room !== room.trim().toUpperCase() || marketForTable(room, team) !== market : room !== "PRACTICE") ||
      !Array.isArray(history) || history.length > ROUNDS.length) throw new Error("Invalid team or room record.");
  const clean = {
    game: CONFIG.game, version: CONFIG.version, mode, team, market, room,
    session: cleanText(record.session), content: typeof record.content === "string" ? record.content.slice(0, 16) : "", history: [], drafts: {},
    notes: normalizeNotes(record.notes), bulletinB: mode === "practice" && record.bulletinB === true,
    brief: typeof record.brief === "string" ? record.brief.slice(0, CONFIG.maxNote * 3) : ""
  };
  if (!clean.session) throw new Error("The record is missing a session ID.");
  if (mode === "practice" && history.length >= 6 && !clean.bulletinB) throw new Error("The emergency decision is missing bulletin B.");
  clean.history = history.map((event, index) => {
    const round = ROUNDS[index];
    const at = Date.parse(event?.at);
    if (!Number.isFinite(at)) throw new Error("Invalid timestamp in " + round.id + ".");
    if (mode === "live") {
      const first = startOfRound(room, round.id) + (round.id === "R6" && event.method === "submitted" ? 8 * MINUTE : 0);
      const last = endOfRound(room, round.id);
      const timely = event.method === "submitted" ? at >= first && at < last : at === last;
      if (!timely) throw new Error("Decision timestamp does not match the room schedule.");
    }
    return {round: event.round, choice: event.choice, method: event.method, at: new Date(at).toISOString(),
      evidence: cleanText(event.evidence), tradeoff: cleanText(event.tradeoff),
      ...(typeof event.problem === "string" && event.problem ? {problem: event.problem.slice(0, 24)} : {})};
  });
  replay(clean);
  for (const {id} of ROUNDS) {
    const draft = record.drafts?.[id];
    if (!draft || typeof draft !== "object") continue;
    clean.drafts[id] = {choice: cleanText(draft.choice), evidence: cleanText(draft.evidence), tradeoff: cleanText(draft.tradeoff),
      ...(typeof draft.problem === "string" && draft.problem ? {problem: draft.problem.slice(0, 24)} : {})};
  }
  return clean;
}

function checkedCount(expert, row) {
  const checks = expert?.checks?.[row];
  return Array.isArray(checks) ? checks.slice(0, 4).filter(check => check === true).length : 0;
}

// One expert's points: every ticked check is worth a quarter of its row's weight.
function scoreExpert(expert) {
  let written = 0;
  let oral = 0;
  let uppsala = 0;
  RUBRIC.forEach(([section, name, weight], index) => {
    const points = checkedCount(expert, index) * weight / 4;
    if (section === "Written") written += points;
    else oral += points;
    if (name === "Uppsala and entry route") uppsala += points;
  });
  return {written, oral, uppsala, total: written + oral};
}

function scoreJury(submissions) {
  if (!Array.isArray(submissions) || submissions.length !== 3 || ![0, 1, 2].every(index => submissions[index]?.complete)) return null;
  let written = 0;
  let oral = 0;
  let uppsala = 0;
  for (const expert of submissions) {
    const score = scoreExpert(expert);
    written += score.written;
    oral += score.oral;
    uppsala += score.uppsala;
  }
  return {written: written / 3, oral: oral / 3, uppsala: uppsala / 3, total: (written + oral) / 3};
}

function compareScores(a, b) {
  return b.total - a.total || b.oral - a.oral || b.uppsala - a.uppsala;
}

// The hidden game result, 0-100: what the Board can be asked for, how well the ask is supported by evidence
// and how much budget was kept. It is built from the saved state, so it needs no extra storage.
function gameScore(record) {
  const {state, path} = replay(record);
  if (path.length !== ROUNDS.length) return null;
  const table = tuning().scoring;
  const ask = path.at(-1).choice;
  const parts = [["Request to the Board · " + ask, table.ask[ask] ?? 0], ["Customer research · " + state.research, table.research[state.research] ?? 0]];
  if (state.verified) parts.push(["Readiness check", table.verified]);
  if (state.narrow) parts.push(["Narrowed proposition", table.narrow]);
  const response = {hold: table.response.hold, targeted: state.launchEvidence ? table.response.targetedProven : table.response.targetedOpen,
    full: state.launchEvidence ? table.response.fullPassed : table.response.fullFailed}[state.incident];
  parts.push(["Emergency response · " + state.incident, response ?? 0]);
  if (ask === "pilot" && state.cohorts === 2 && state.launchEvidence) parts.push(["Second cohort kept", table.secondCohort]);
  if (ask === "deal" && state.incident === "full") parts.push(["Whole campaign corrected before the deal ask", table.dealFullCorrection]);
  // Unspent credits only count when there is a real step to fund, so hoarding behind a deferral earns nothing.
  if (["pilot", "pilot2", "deal"].includes(ask)) parts.push(["Reserve kept", Math.min(state.credits, table.creditCap) * table.credit]);
  const total = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, parts.reduce((sum, [, points]) => sum + points, 0)));
  return {total, parts: parts.map(([label, points]) => ({label, points}))};
}

// The final grade: expert score (0-100) and game score (0-100) in the configured proportion.
function finalScore(jury, game, share = tuning().gameShare) {
  return jury * (1 - share) + game * share;
}

// Table by table: the expert score, the game result (from the team's data in Google Sheets) and the final grade.
// The final grade needs the game result only while the game counts towards the grade.
function standings(grades, records = {}) {
  const share = tuning().gameShare;
  const rows = TEAMS.map(team => {
    const jury = scoreJury(grades?.[team]);
    const game = share > 0 && records?.[team] ? (gameScore(records[team])?.total ?? null) : null;
    const ready = !!jury && (share === 0 || game !== null);
    const final = ready ? finalScore(jury.total, game ?? 0, share) : null;
    return {team, jury, game, final, key: ready ? {total: final, oral: jury.oral, uppsala: jury.uppsala} : null};
  });
  const ranks = rankScores(rows.map(row => row.key));
  return rows.map((row, index) => ({...row, rank: ranks[index],
    tied: !!row.key && rows.some((other, rival) => rival !== index && other.key && compareScores(other.key, row.key) === 0)}));
}

// The facilitator's "what's next" list. Only the facilitator's own browser knows these facts: the room,
// the clock, the team data read from the sheet and the expert sheets. Whether the teams have joined cannot be seen,
// so that step is ticked by hand.
function hostChecklist({room, now, grades, records}) {
  const phase = phaseAt(room, now);
  const counted = tuning().gameShare > 0;
  const full = TEAMS.filter(team => records?.[team]?.history?.length === ROUNDS.length);
  const partial = TEAMS.filter(team => records?.[team] && records[team].history.length < ROUNDS.length);
  const missing = TEAMS.filter(team => !full.includes(team));
  const sheets = TEAMS.reduce((sum, team) => sum + [0, 1, 2].filter(expert => grades?.[team]?.[expert]?.complete).length, 0);
  const ranked = standings(grades, records).every(row => row.key);
  const finished = ["PREP", "PITCH", "DEBRIEF", "END"].includes(phase.id);
  const list = (teams) => teams.map(team => "team " + team).join(", ");
  const steps = [
    {id: "started", title: "Game started", done: true, detail: "The teams were formed and the game began. Each team plays on its captain’s device."},
    {id: "game", title: "The game is played", done: finished,
      detail: finished ? "All seven rounds are over." : phase.id === "SETUP" ? "R1 has not started yet." : "The rounds are running."},
    {id: "files", title: "Team data from Google Sheets", done: counted ? full.length === TEAMS.length : true,
      detail: (counted ? "" : "Optional without a game result. ") + full.length + " of " + TEAMS.length + " teams have all " + ROUNDS.length + " decisions" +
        (missing.length ? ". Missing: " + list(missing) : "") + (partial.length ? ". Still playing: " + list(partial) : "") + "."},
    {id: "sheets", title: "Expert sheets complete", done: sheets === TEAMS.length * 3,
      detail: sheets + " of " + TEAMS.length * 3 + " sheets are marked complete (three experts for each of four teams)."},
    {id: "ranking", title: "Ranking and export", done: ranked,
      detail: ranked ? "The ranking is ready: check it and export the scores." : "Ready when the two steps above are done."}
  ];
  const current = steps.findIndex(step => !step.done);
  const next = {
    game: phase.id === "SETUP" ? "Wait for R1. Explain the mandate and run the practice example." : "Run the seminar. The teams’ data is saved in Google Sheets as they play.",
    files: "Teams finish R7 and their decisions and notes appear here from Google Sheets. Press Refresh now if you do not want to wait.",
    sheets: "The three experts complete their score sheets for every team.",
    ranking: "Check the ranking and export the CSV."
  }[steps[current]?.id] ?? "Everything is done. Keep the team journals and the exported scores.";
  return {phase, steps: steps.map((step, index) => ({...step, state: step.done ? "done" : index === current ? "now" : "later"})), next};
}

// Competition ranking: equal scores share a rank. Entries without a score have no rank.
function rankScores(scores) {
  return scores.map(score => score ? 1 + scores.filter(other => other && compareScores(other, score) < 0).length : null);
}
return { SCHEDULE, TEAMS, PRICE, price, problemFor, OUTCOMES, CONTENT_ID, contentMismatch, makeRoom, roomStart, marketForTable, phaseAt, initialProgress, optionsFor, pendingFact, isDraftComplete, replay, settleDeadlines, lockRound, canReadBulletinB, assertOpen, updateDraft, updateNote, updateBrief, validateRecord, scoreExpert, scoreJury, compareScores, gameScore, finalScore, standings, hostChecklist, rankScores };
})();

// src/progress.mjs
const __omf_progress = (() => {
const { ROUNDS } = __omf_scenario;
const { tuning, useTuning } = __omf_tuning;
const { optionsFor, replay, gameScore, problemFor } = __omf_rules;
// What the player sees of the hidden game result while playing: the points already earned and the most
// the result can still reach. The ceiling comes from searching the rest of the decision tree.

const WHEN = "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z";

// One more decision, as the search takes it. A one-channel correction names the problem the customers
// are confused about (the best case).
function advance(record, choice) {
  const round = ROUNDS[record.history.length].id;
  const problem = round === "R6" && choice === "targeted" ? {problem: problemFor(record.market, record.history[0].choice)} : {};
  return {...record, history: [...record.history, {round, choice, method: "submitted", at: WHEN, evidence: "e", tradeoff: "t", ...problem}]};
}

const cache = new Map();

// The highest game result still reachable, assuming the best case in the full retest.
function bestReachable(record) {
  const settings = tuning();
  const key = settings.name + "|" + record.market + "|" + record.history.map(event => event.choice + (event.problem ? ":" + event.problem : "")).join(">");
  if (cache.has(key)) return cache.get(key);

  let forced = [0, 0];
  const chance = settings.randomness.retestSpread > 0;
  const restore = chance ? useTuning({...settings, randomness: {...settings.randomness, draw: name => forced[name.endsWith("|2") ? 1 : 0]}}) : () => {};
  try {
    const search = current => {
      if (current.history.length === ROUNDS.length) return gameScore(current).total;
      const round = ROUNDS[current.history.length];
      const state = replay(current).state;
      let best = 0;
      for (const item of optionsFor(round.id, state, current.market)) {
        if (item.blocked) continue;
        const next = advance(current, item.id);
        if (chance && round.id === "R6" && item.id === "full") {
          const draws = state.cohorts === 2 ? [-1, 0, 1].flatMap(a => [-1, 0, 1].map(b => [a, b])) : [-1, 0, 1].map(a => [a, 0]);
          for (const combo of draws) {
            forced = combo;
            best = Math.max(best, search(next));
          }
          forced = [0, 0];
        } else {
          best = Math.max(best, search(next));
        }
      }
      return best;
    };
    const value = search(record);
    cache.set(key, value);
    return value;
  } finally {
    restore();
  }
}

// {earned, possible, final, parts}: `earned` counts what is already decided (research, checks, the emergency
// response, and after R7 the request and the reserve); `possible` is the ceiling; `final` is set after R7.
function gameProgress(record) {
  const decided = record.history.length;
  if (decided === ROUNDS.length) {
    const result = gameScore(record);
    return {earned: result.total, possible: result.total, final: result.total, parts: result.parts};
  }
  const table = tuning().scoring;
  const parts = [];
  if (decided > 0) {
    const {state} = replay(record);
    if (decided >= 2) parts.push({label: "Customer research", points: table.research[state.research] ?? 0});
    if (decided >= 4 && state.verified) parts.push({label: "Readiness check", points: table.verified});
    if (decided >= 5 && state.narrow) parts.push({label: "Narrowed proposition", points: table.narrow});
    if (decided >= 6) {
      const response = {hold: table.response.hold, targeted: state.launchEvidence ? table.response.targetedProven : table.response.targetedOpen,
        full: state.launchEvidence ? table.response.fullPassed : table.response.fullFailed}[state.incident] ?? 0;
      parts.push({label: "Emergency response", points: response});
    }
  }
  const earned = parts.reduce((sum, part) => sum + part.points, 0);
  return {earned, possible: Math.max(earned, bestReachable(record)), final: null, parts};
}
return { bestReachable, gameProgress };
})();

// src/clock.mjs
const __omf_clock = (() => {
// One shared notion of "now" for every device in the room.
// Device clocks drift, and a round that closes early writes an irreversible default decision.
// The page's own web server already knows the time: its HTTP `Date` header is the reference,
// so no extra service is needed. Opened from a file (no server), the device clock is used as is.

const SAMPLES = 3;
const state = {offset: 0, synced: false, error: "", rtt: null};

function trueNow() {
  return Date.now() + state.offset;
}

function clockStatus() {
  return {...state};
}

// Offset between the server and this device from one HEAD request.
// The Date header has 1 s resolution (the real time is header + [0, 1 s)), so add half a second.
// A cached response (CDN) ages: add the Age header. Assume a symmetric network delay.
function offsetFromResponse(response, sentAt, receivedAt) {
  const header = Date.parse(response.headers.get("Date"));
  if (!Number.isFinite(header)) throw new Error("The server did not send a Date header.");
  const age = Number(response.headers.get("Age")) || 0;
  const serverTime = header + age * 1000 + 500;
  return {offset: serverTime - (sentAt + receivedAt) / 2, rtt: receivedAt - sentAt};
}

async function syncClock({url = globalThis.location?.href, request = globalThis.fetch, now = Date.now} = {}) {
  if (!url || !/^https?:/.test(url) || typeof request !== "function") {
    state.error = "Open the page from the web to synchronize the clock.";
    throw new Error(state.error);
  }
  try {
    const samples = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < SAMPLES; index++) {
      const sentAt = now();
      const response = await request(url, {method: "HEAD", cache: "no-store"});
      samples.push(offsetFromResponse(response, sentAt, now()));
    }
    // The sample with the shortest round trip has the smallest delay uncertainty.
    const best = samples.reduce((a, b) => (b.rtt < a.rtt ? b : a));
    Object.assign(state, {offset: best.offset, rtt: best.rtt, synced: true, error: ""});
    return clockStatus();
  } catch (error) {
    state.error = error.message || "Clock synchronization failed.";
    throw error;
  }
}

function resetClock() {
  Object.assign(state, {offset: 0, synced: false, error: "", rtt: null});
}
return { trueNow, clockStatus, offsetFromResponse, syncClock, resetClock };
})();

// src/storage.mjs
const __omf_storage = (() => {
const { CONFIG } = __omf_scenario;
const { TEAMS, roomStart, validateRecord, CONTENT_ID } = __omf_rules;
const prefix = CONFIG.game + ":" + CONFIG.version;
const memory = new Map();
let writable = true;

function storageAvailable() {
  return writable;
}

function getStored(key) {
  if (writable) {
    try {
      const value = localStorage.getItem(key);
      if (value === null) memory.delete(key);
      else memory.set(key, value);
      return value;
    } catch {
      writable = false;
    }
  }
  return memory.get(key) ?? null;
}

function putStored(key, value) {
  if (value === null) memory.delete(key);
  else memory.set(key, value);
  if (writable) {
    try {
      if (value === null) localStorage.removeItem(key);
      else localStorage.setItem(key, value);
    } catch {
      writable = false;
    }
  }
}

function teamKey(room, team) {
  return prefix + ":" + room + ":team:" + team;
}

function hostKey(room) {
  return prefix + ":" + room + ":facilitator";
}

function syncKey(room, team) {
  return prefix + ":" + room + ":sync:" + team;
}

const SNAPSHOTS = ["bak1", "bak2"];

// A save that cannot be opened. The app offers recovery instead of a dead end.
class SaveError extends Error {
  constructor(message, {room, team} = {}) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "SaveError";
    this.room = room;
    this.team = team;
  }
}

function parseSlot(raw, room, team) {
  let parsed;
  try { parsed = JSON.parse(raw); }
  catch { throw new SaveError("The saved data is damaged and cannot be read.", {room, team}); }
  try {
    const record = validateRecord(parsed);
    if (record.room !== room || record.team !== team) throw new Error("This saved record belongs to a different table.");
    return record;
  } catch (error) {
    throw new SaveError(error.message || "The saved game could not be read.", {room, team});
  }
}

function readSlot(room, team) {
  const raw = getStored(teamKey(room, team));
  return raw === null ? null : parseSlot(raw, room, team);
}

function historyLength(raw) {
  try {
    const length = JSON.parse(raw)?.history?.length;
    return Number.isInteger(length) ? length : -1;
  } catch {
    return -1;
  }
}

// Every time the list of locked decisions changes, the previous good save moves into a two-step ring.
// Draft edits do not rotate the ring, so the snapshots stay one decision apart.
function rotateSnapshots(key, previous) {
  const [first, second] = SNAPSHOTS.map(slot => key + ":" + slot);
  const older = getStored(first);
  if (older !== null) {
    putStored(second, older);
    void mirrorPut(second, older);
  }
  putStored(first, previous);
  void mirrorPut(first, previous);
}

function storeRecord(record) {
  const key = teamKey(record.room, record.team);
  const next = JSON.stringify(record);
  const previous = getStored(key);
  if (previous !== null && previous !== next) {
    const before = historyLength(previous);
    if (before >= 0 && before !== record.history.length) rotateSnapshots(key, previous);
  }
  putStored(key, next);
  void mirrorPut(key, next);
}

function clearSlot(room, team) {
  const key = teamKey(room, team);
  for (const name of [key, ...SNAPSHOTS.map(slot => key + ":" + slot), syncKey(room, team)]) {
    putStored(name, null);
    void mirrorPut(name, null);
  }
}

// ---- Second copy in IndexedDB -------------------------------------------------------------
// Protects against failed or partial localStorage writes, quota errors and damaged values.
// Browsers usually clear both stores together, so the real copy is the one in Google Sheets.

const mirrorState = {ok: null};
let mirrorDatabase = null;

function openMirror() {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!globalThis.indexedDB) return reject(new Error("IndexedDB is unavailable."));
    const request = indexedDB.open(prefix, 1);
    request.onupgradeneeded = () => request.result.createObjectStore("kv");
    request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    request.onblocked = () => reject(new Error("IndexedDB is blocked."));
  });
}

function database() {
  mirrorDatabase ||= openMirror().catch(() => null);
  return mirrorDatabase;
}

function transaction(db, mode, work) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction("kv", mode);
    const result = work(tx.objectStore("kv"));
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(result?.result);
    tx.onerror = tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

async function mirrorPut(key, value) {
  try {
    const db = await database();
    if (!db) { mirrorState.ok = false; return; }
    await transaction(db, "readwrite", store => value === null ? store.delete(key) : store.put(value, key));
    mirrorState.ok = true;
  } catch {
    mirrorState.ok = false;
  }
}

async function mirrorGet(key) {
  try {
    const db = await database();
    if (!db) return null;
    return (await transaction(db, "readonly", store => store.get(key))) ?? null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function mirrorStatus() {
  return mirrorState.ok;
}

// ---- Recovery -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Readable copies of a table's save: the two snapshots and the IndexedDB mirror, best first.
async function recoveryOptions(room, team) {
  const key = teamKey(room, team);
  const candidates = [
    ...SNAPSHOTS.map(slot => ({source: "snapshot " + slot, raw: getStored(key + ":" + slot)})),
    {source: "browser copy", raw: await mirrorGet(key)}
  ];
  const seen = new Set();
  const options = [];
  for (const {source, raw} of candidates) {
    if (raw === null || seen.has(raw)) continue;
    seen.add(raw);
    try {
      const record = parseSlot(raw, room, team);
      options.push({source, record, rounds: record.history.length});
    } catch { /* unreadable copy: not offered */ }
  }
  return options.sort((a, b) => b.rounds - a.rounds);
}

// ---- Persistence ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

const persistence = {state: "unknown"};

async function requestPersistence() {
  try {
    if (!navigator.storage?.persist) persistence.state = "unsupported";
    else if (await navigator.storage.persisted()) persistence.state = "granted";
    else persistence.state = (await navigator.storage.persist()) ? "granted" : "denied";
  } catch {
    persistence.state = "unsupported";
  }
  return persistence.state;
}

function persistenceState() {
  return persistence.state;
}

// What the remote sheet has confirmed for one table and endpoint: how many decisions, and a fingerprint of
// every worksheet note and of the Board Brief as last sent.
function readSyncState(room, team, endpoint) {
  const empty = {count: 0, notes: {}, brief: null};
  try {
    const value = JSON.parse(getStored(syncKey(room, team)));
    if (value?.endpoint !== endpoint) return empty;
    return {
      count: Number.isInteger(value.count) && value.count >= 0 ? value.count : 0,
      notes: value.notes && typeof value.notes === "object" ? value.notes : {},
      brief: typeof value.brief === "string" ? value.brief : null
    };
  } catch {
    return empty;
  }
}

function writeSyncState(room, team, endpoint, {count, notes, brief}) {
  putStored(syncKey(room, team), JSON.stringify({endpoint, count, notes, brief}));
}

function readSynced(room, team, endpoint) {
  return readSyncState(room, team, endpoint).count;
}

function writeSynced(room, team, endpoint, count) {
  const state = readSyncState(room, team, endpoint);
  writeSyncState(room, team, endpoint, {...state, count});
}

// The player of this device: a secret pass the sheet recognizes, and the name shown to teammates.
function readPlayer() {
  try {
    const value = JSON.parse(getStored(prefix + ":player"));
    return typeof value?.id === "string" && value.id.length >= 16 && typeof value.name === "string" ? {id: value.id, name: value.name} : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function writePlayer(player) {
  putStored(prefix + ":player", player ? JSON.stringify({id: player.id, name: player.name}) : null);
}

function activeTeam(value) {
  const key = prefix + ":active";
  try {
    if (value === undefined) return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(key));
    if (value === null) sessionStorage.removeItem(key);
    else sessionStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function newId() {
  return globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() || Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36);
}

function newRecord(mode, room, team, market) {
  return validateRecord({
    game: CONFIG.game, version: CONFIG.version, content: CONTENT_ID, mode, room, team, market,
    session: newId(), history: [], drafts: {}, notes: {}, brief: "", bulletinB: false
  });
}

function withSaveLock(key, change) {
  return navigator.locks?.request(key, change) || Promise.resolve().then(change);
}

function knownTable(value) {
  return value && TEAMS.includes(value.team) && (value.room === "PRACTICE" || roomStart(value.room) !== null);
}
return { storageAvailable, getStored, putStored, teamKey, hostKey, SaveError, readSlot, storeRecord, clearSlot, mirrorPut, mirrorGet, mirrorStatus, recoveryOptions, requestPersistence, persistenceState, readSyncState, writeSyncState, readSynced, writeSynced, readPlayer, writePlayer, activeTeam, newId, newRecord, withSaveLock, knownTable };
})();

// src/sync.mjs
const __omf_sync = (() => {
const { ROUNDS } = __omf_scenario;
const { replay, gameScore, validateRecord } = __omf_rules;
const { hash53 } = __omf_hash;
const { trueNow, clockStatus } = __omf_clock;
const { readSyncState, writeSyncState, newRecord } = __omf_storage;
// Optional second copy of every locked decision in a Google Sheet (Apps Script web app).
// The game never depends on it: decisions are always saved locally first, the number of confirmed
// decisions is remembered per table, and a failed send is simply retried with the same events.
// Events carry a deterministic id, so the sheet can drop duplicates and a re-send is always safe.

const SEPARATOR = "␟";
const state = {endpoint: "", status: "off", total: 0, pending: 0, pendingNotes: 0, error: "", participant: ""};
let sending = null;

function configureSync(url) {
  const endpoint = String(url || "").trim();
  state.endpoint = /^(https:\/\/[^\s]+|http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)(:\d+)?\/[^\s]*)$/.test(endpoint) ? endpoint : "";
  state.status = state.endpoint ? "idle" : "off";
  state.error = "";
}

// The player's secret pass: the sheet accepts a team's decisions and notes only from a player of that team.
function setParticipant(id) {
  state.participant = String(id || "");
}

function syncStatus() {
  return {...state};
}

// One event per locked decision. Each carries a chain hash over everything locked before it,
// so a decision that was rewritten later produces a different chain for the same round.
function buildEvents(record) {
  const {path} = replay(record);
  let chain = "";
  return record.history.map((event, seq) => {
    const body = [record.room, record.team, seq, event.round, event.choice, event.method, event.at, event.evidence, event.tradeoff, event.problem ?? ""].join(SEPARATOR);
    chain = hash53(chain + SEPARATOR + body);
    const step = path[seq];
    return {
      id: record.room + ":" + record.team + ":" + seq + ":" + chain,
      room: record.room, team: record.team, market: record.market, session: record.session, seq,
      round: event.round, choice: event.choice, method: event.method, label: step.label, cost: step.cost, credits: step.credits,
      clientTime: event.at, evidence: event.evidence, tradeoff: event.tradeoff, problem: event.problem ?? "", chain, content: record.content || "",
      // After the last decision the hidden game result is known; the sheet shows it next to the team.
      game: seq === ROUNDS.length - 1 ? gameScore(record).total : ""
    };
  });
}

// The leading run of events that the sheet reports as stored (or already there).
function confirmedPrefix(events, reply) {
  const known = new Set([...(reply.saved || []), ...(reply.duplicates || [])]);
  let count = 0;
  while (count < events.length && known.has(events[count].id)) count++;
  return count;
}

// One request to the sheet. A reply that cannot be read from this page (or no network) falls back to an opaque
// request; the result then says it was not confirmed.
async function post(payload, request) {
  const options = {method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type": "text/plain;charset=utf-8"}, body: JSON.stringify(payload), redirect: "follow"};
  try {
    const response = await request(state.endpoint, options);
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error("The sheet answered with status " + response.status + ".");
    const reply = await response.json();
    if (!reply?.ok) throw new Error(reply?.error || "The sheet rejected the request.");
    return {reply, readable: true};
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof TypeError)) throw error;
    await request(state.endpoint, {...options, mode: "no-cors"});
    return {reply: null, readable: false};
  }
}

const envelope = () => ({v: 1, participant: state.participant, sentAt: new Date(trueNow()).toISOString(), clockOffsetMs: Math.round(clockStatus().offset)});

// Worksheet notes and the Board Brief that changed since they were last sent.
function buildNotesPayload(record, sent) {
  const items = [];
  const hashes = {};
  const at = new Date(trueNow()).toISOString();
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(record.notes)) {
    const hash = hash53(value);
    hashes[key] = hash;
    if (sent.notes[key] !== hash) {
      const [round, field] = key.split(".");
      items.push({round, field, text: value, at});
    }
  }
  const briefHash = hash53(record.brief);
  const briefChanged = sent.brief !== briefHash && (record.brief !== "" || sent.brief !== null);
  return {items, brief: briefChanged ? {text: record.brief, at} : null, hashes, briefHash};
}

async function run(record, request, force) {
  try {
    const events = buildEvents(record);
    let sent = force ? {count: 0, notes: {}, brief: null} : readSyncState(record.room, record.team, state.endpoint);
    const unsent = events.slice(sent.count);
    const notes = buildNotesPayload(record, sent);
    const notesWaiting = notes.items.length + (notes.brief ? 1 : 0);
    state.total = events.length;
    state.pending = unsent.length;
    state.pendingNotes = notesWaiting;
    if (!unsent.length && !notesWaiting) {
      state.status = events.length || Object.keys(record.notes).length ? (state.status === "unconfirmed" ? "unconfirmed" : "ok") : "idle";
      return syncStatus();
    }
    state.status = "sending";
    let readable = true;
    let rejected = 0;

    if (unsent.length) {
      const result = await post({...envelope(), events: unsent}, request);
      readable = readable && result.readable;
      const confirmed = result.readable ? confirmedPrefix(unsent, result.reply) : unsent.length;
      rejected += result.readable ? (result.reply.rejected || []).length : 0;
      sent = {...sent, count: sent.count + confirmed};
      writeSyncState(record.room, record.team, state.endpoint, sent);
      state.pending = unsent.length - confirmed;
    }
    if (notesWaiting && !state.pending) {
      const result = await post({...envelope(), type: "notes", room: record.room, team: record.team, market: record.market, session: record.session,
        items: notes.items, ...(notes.brief ? {brief: notes.brief} : {})}, request);
      readable = readable && result.readable;
      rejected += result.readable ? (result.reply.rejected || []).length : 0;
      sent = {...sent, notes: notes.hashes, brief: notes.briefHash};
      writeSyncState(record.room, record.team, state.endpoint, sent);
      state.pendingNotes = 0;
    }
    state.error = rejected ? "The sheet rejected " + rejected + " item(s)." : "";
    state.status = state.pending || state.pendingNotes ? "retry" : readable ? "ok" : "unconfirmed";
  } catch (error) {
    state.status = "retry";
    state.error = error.message || "The sheet could not be reached.";
  }
  return syncStatus();
}

// Sends every decision and note the sheet has not confirmed yet. Safe to call as often as needed.
// A call that arrives while a send is running is not lost: once that send ends, one more runs with the
// newest record, so notes typed meanwhile are included.
let waiting = null;

function flushSync(record, {request = globalThis.fetch, force = false} = {}) {
  if (!state.endpoint || record.mode !== "live") return Promise.resolve(syncStatus());
  if (sending) {
    waiting = {record, request};
    return sending;
  }
  sending = (async () => {
    try {
      let result = await run(record, request, force);
      while (waiting) {
        const next = waiting;
        waiting = null;
        result = await run(next.record, next.request, false);
      }
      return result;
    } finally {
      sending = null;
    }
  })();
  return sending;
}

function syncSummary() {
  const {status, total, pending, pendingNotes, error} = state;
  const waiting = [pending ? pending + (pending === 1 ? " decision" : " decisions") : "", pendingNotes ? pendingNotes + (pendingNotes === 1 ? " note" : " notes") : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" and ");
  const text = {
    ok: "Google Sheets: all " + total + (total === 1 ? " decision is" : " decisions are") + " saved with your notes.",
    sending: "Google Sheets: sending…",
    idle: "Google Sheets: connected. Decisions and notes are sent as you write.",
    unconfirmed: "Google Sheets: sent, but the browser cannot read the reply. Check the sheet, or send again.",
    retry: "Google Sheets: " + waiting + " waiting to be sent. Retrying automatically." + (error ? " (" + error + ")" : "")
  }[status];
  return text ? {state: status, text} : null;
}

// ---- Talking to the sheet -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The sheet is the only store. A player's page asks it which team the player is in and, once the game runs, for the
// team's earlier game (continuing on another device). The facilitator's page forms the teams, starts the game and
// reads every team. The room code is an internal detail: players never type it.

function syncEnabled() {
  return !!state.endpoint;
}

async function read(query, request) {
  const url = state.endpoint + (state.endpoint.includes("?") ? "&" : "?") + new URLSearchParams(query);
  const response = await request(url, {method: "GET", redirect: "follow", cache: "no-store"});
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error("The sheet answered with status " + response.status + ".");
  const reply = await response.json();
  if (!reply?.ok) throw new Error(reply?.error || "The sheet could not answer.");
  return reply;
}

async function command(body, request) {
  const response = await request(state.endpoint, {method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type": "text/plain;charset=utf-8"}, redirect: "follow",
    body: JSON.stringify({v: 1, ...body})});
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error("The sheet answered with status " + response.status + ".");
  const reply = await response.json();
  if (!reply?.ok) throw new Error(reply?.error || "The sheet did not accept the request.");
  return reply;
}

const withRequest = ({request = globalThis.fetch} = {}) => request;

// Player: {found, state: lobby | formed | started, team, captain, ready, members, room, start}
function joinGame(id, name, international, options) {
  return command({type: "join", id, name, international}, withRequest(options));
}

function fetchMe(id, options) {
  return read({action: "me", id}, withRequest(options));
}

function setReady(id, ready, options) {
  return command({type: "ready", id, ready}, withRequest(options));
}

function claimCaptain(id, options) {
  return command({type: "captain", id}, withRequest(options));
}

// The player's own team: its decisions and notes.
function fetchTeam(id, options) {
  return read({action: "team", id}, withRequest(options));
}

// Facilitator
function fetchRoster(token, options) {
  return read({action: "roster", token}, withRequest(options));
}

function fetchRoom(token, options) {
  return read({action: "room", token}, withRequest(options));
}

// type: form | start | reset | demo
function hostCommand(type, token, extra = {}, options) {
  return command({type, token, ...extra}, withRequest(options));
}

function pushScores(token, table, options) {
  return command({type: "scores", token, table}, withRequest(options));
}

// A team's saved game rebuilt from what the sheet holds. The record is checked like any other save.
function recordFromPayload(payload, market) {
  const notes = {};
  for (const item of payload.notes || []) notes[item.round + "." + item.field] = item.text;
  const base = newRecord("live", payload.room, payload.team, market);
  return validateRecord({
    ...base, notes, brief: payload.brief?.text ?? "",
    history: (payload.decisions || []).map(item => ({round: item.round, choice: item.choice, method: item.method, at: item.at,
      evidence: item.evidence, tradeoff: item.tradeoff, ...(item.problem ? {problem: item.problem} : {})}))
  });
}
return { configureSync, setParticipant, syncStatus, buildEvents, buildNotesPayload, flushSync, syncSummary, syncEnabled, joinGame, fetchMe, setReady, claimCaptain, fetchTeam, fetchRoster, fetchRoom, hostCommand, pushScores, recordFromPayload };
})();

// src/presentation.mjs
const __omf_presentation = (() => {
const { MARKETS, ROUNDS, WORKSHEET, CONFIG, QUESTION, RUBRIC } = __omf_scenario;
const { OUTCOMES, TEAMS, replay, roomStart, marketForTable, scoreExpert, standings } = __omf_rules;
const { tuning } = __omf_tuning;
function esc(value) {
  return String(value ?? "").replaceAll("&", "&amp;").replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
    .replaceAll(">", "&gt;").replaceAll('"', "&quot;").replaceAll("'", "&#39;");
}

function button(label, action, kind = "", attributes = "") {
  return '<button type="button" class="pv-button' + (kind ? ' pv-button--' + kind : '') +
    '" data-action="' + action + '" ' + attributes + '>' + esc(label) + '</button>';
}

function disclosure(label, body, open = false) {
  return '<details class="pv-summary"' + (open ? " open" : "") + '><summary>' + esc(label) +
    '</summary><div class="pv-detail-body">' + body + '</div></details>';
}

function facts(pairs, className = "pv-facts") {
  return '<dl class="' + className + '">' + pairs.map(([label, value]) =>
    '<div><dt>' + esc(label) + '</dt><dd>' + esc(value) + '</dd></div>').join("") + '</dl>';
}

function stage(title, label, body, tone = "") {
  return '<section class="pv-stage" aria-labelledby="omf-stage-title"><header class="pv-stage-head' +
    (tone ? ' pv-stage-head--' + tone : '') + '"><p class="pv-mono">' + esc(label) +
    '</p><h2 id="omf-stage-title" tabindex="-1">' + esc(title) +
    '</h2></header><div class="pv-stage-body">' + body + '</div></section>';
}

function saveFile(filename, data, mime) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data], {type: mime}));
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename;
  document.body.append(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

const moscowClock = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {timeZone: "Europe/Moscow", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23"});

function interval(room, start, end) {
  const base = roomStart(room);
  return moscowClock.format(base + start * 60_000) + "–" + moscowClock.format(base + end * 60_000);
}

function countdown(delta) {
  const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(delta / 1000));
  const pad = value => String(value).padStart(2, "0");
  const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
  const rest = seconds % 3600;
  const minutes = pad(Math.floor(rest / 60)) + ":" + pad(rest % 60);
  return hours ? hours + ":" + minutes : minutes;
}

function textReport(record, boardOnly = false) {
  const {state, path} = replay(record);
  const market = MARKETS[record.market];
  const profile = market.profiles[state.profile];
  const lines = [
    boardOnly ? "REVOLUT · BOARD BRIEF" : "REVOLUT · TEAM DECISION JOURNAL",
    "Table " + record.team + " · " + market.name + " · " + record.room,
    "Customer: " + (profile?.name || "Pending"),
    "Credits spent: " + (CONFIG.budget - state.credits) + " · remaining: " + state.credits
  ];
  if (path.length === ROUNDS.length) lines.push("Funding request: " + OUTCOMES[path.at(-1).choice][0]);
  if (record.brief) lines.push("", record.brief);
  if (!boardOnly) {
    for (const event of path) {
      lines.push("", event.round + " " + event.label + " · cost " + event.cost + " · balance " + event.credits + " · " + event.method);
      if (event.evidence) lines.push("Evidence: " + event.evidence);
      if (event.tradeoff) lines.push("Trade-off: " + event.tradeoff);
      if (event.result) lines.push("Result: " + event.result);
      for (const [field, label] of WORKSHEET[event.round]) {
        const value = record.notes[event.round + "." + field];
        if (value) lines.push(label + ": " + value);
      }
    }
  } else {
    if (!record.brief) lines.push("", "Team worksheet highlights:");
    const fields = [["R1.cage", "CAGE"], ["R3.later", "Next commitment"], ["R6.approval", "Reopening condition"], ["R7.board", "Board request"]];
    for (const [key, label] of fields) {
      if (!record.brief && record.notes[key]) lines.push(label + ": " + record.notes[key]);
    }
    lines.push("", "For the hearing: " + QUESTION);
  }
  return lines.join("\n");
}

function teamFilename(record, extension, name = "journal") {
  return "revolut-" + record.room.toLowerCase() + "-table-" + record.team + "-" + record.market + "-" + name + "." + extension;
}

// RFC 4180: quote a cell that contains the separator, a quote or a line break, and double inner quotes.
function csvCell(value, separator = ",") {
  const text = String(value ?? "");
  const quote = text.includes('"') || text.includes(separator) || /[\r\n]/.test(text) || text !== text.trim();
  return quote ? '"' + text.replaceAll('"', '""') + '"' : text;
}

// The score table as CSV. `records` are the teams' games read from Google Sheets: the game result comes from them.
// `russianExcel` writes ";" separators and decimal commas, which is what Excel with Russian regional
// settings expects. A BOM makes Excel read the file as UTF-8.
function scoresCsv(room, gradesByTeam, {russianExcel = false, records = {}} = {}) {
  const separator = russianExcel ? ";" : ",";
  const number = value => (russianExcel ? value.toFixed(1).replace(".", ",") : value.toFixed(1));
  const counted = tuning().gameShare > 0;
  const header = ["rank", "table", "market", "written_70", "oral_30", "uppsala_16"]
    .concat(counted ? ["expert_total_100", "game_100", "final_100"] : ["total_100"], ["expert1_total", "expert2_total", "expert3_total", "status"]);
  const lines = [header].concat(standings(gradesByTeam, records).map(row => {
    const grades = Array.isArray(gradesByTeam?.[row.team]) ? gradesByTeam[row.team] : [];
    const experts = [0, 1, 2].map(expert => grades[expert]?.complete ? number(scoreExpert(grades[expert]).total) : "");
    const done = [0, 1, 2].filter(expert => grades[expert]?.complete).length;
    const status = row.key ? (row.tied ? "tied: the Chair decides" : "complete") :
      row.jury ? "pending: waiting for the team’s data in Google Sheets" : "pending: " + done + " of 3 expert sheets complete";
    const jury = row.jury ? [row.jury.written, row.jury.oral, row.jury.uppsala].map(number) : ["", "", ""];
    const totals = counted ? [row.jury ? number(row.jury.total) : "", row.game === null ? "" : number(row.game), row.final === null ? "" : number(row.final)] :
      [row.jury ? number(row.jury.total) : ""];
    return [row.rank ?? "", row.team, MARKETS[marketForTable(room, row.team)].name].concat(jury, totals, experts, [status]);
  }));
  return "\ufeff" + lines.map(line => line.map(cell => csvCell(cell, separator)).join(separator)).join("\r\n") + "\r\n";
}

// The same scores as a table for the Scores sheet in Google Sheets: the ranking of the teams, then every expert's points per
// criterion. Numbers stay numbers so the facilitator can sort and add them there.
function scoresSheetTable(room, gradesByTeam, records = {}) {
  const round = value => Math.round(value * 10) / 10;
  const counted = tuning().gameShare > 0;
  const rows = standings(gradesByTeam, records);
  const table = [["Rank", "Team", "Market", "Written (70)", "Oral (30)", "Uppsala (16)"].concat(counted ? ["Experts (100)", "Game (100)", "Final (100)"] : ["Total (100)"], ["Status"])];
  for (const row of rows) {
    const grades = Array.isArray(gradesByTeam?.[row.team]) ? gradesByTeam[row.team] : [];
    const done = [0, 1, 2].filter(expert => grades[expert]?.complete).length;
    const status = row.key ? (row.tied ? "tied: the Chair decides" : "complete") : row.jury ? "waiting for the team’s game result" : done + " of 3 expert sheets complete";
    const jury = row.jury ? [row.jury.written, row.jury.oral, row.jury.uppsala].map(round) : ["", "", ""];
    const totals = counted ? [row.jury ? round(row.jury.total) : "", row.game === null ? "" : round(row.game), row.final === null ? "" : round(row.final)] : [row.jury ? round(row.jury.total) : ""];
    table.push([row.rank ?? "", row.team, MARKETS[marketForTable(room, row.team)].name].concat(jury, totals, [status]));
  }
  table.push([], ["Expert score sheets"], ["Team", "Market", "Expert", "Status"].concat(RUBRIC.map(([, name, weight]) => name + " (" + weight + ")"), ["Total"]));
  for (const team of TEAMS) {
    const grades = Array.isArray(gradesByTeam?.[team]) ? gradesByTeam[team] : [];
    [0, 1, 2].forEach(expert => {
      const grade = grades[expert];
      const points = RUBRIC.map(([, , weight], index) => (grade?.checks?.[index] || []).filter(Boolean).length * weight / 4);
      table.push([team, MARKETS[marketForTable(room, team)].name, "Expert " + (expert + 1), grade?.complete ? "complete" : grade ? "draft" : "not started"]
        .concat(points.map(round), [round(points.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0))]));
    });
  }
  return table;
}
return { esc, button, disclosure, facts, stage, saveFile, interval, countdown, textReport, teamFilename, csvCell, scoresCsv, scoresSheetTable };
})();

// src/report.mjs
const __omf_report = (() => {
const { CONFIG, MARKETS, MARKET_DOSSIERS, ROUNDS, WORKSHEET, QUESTION } = __omf_scenario;
const { replay, OUTCOMES, gameScore } = __omf_rules;
const { esc } = __omf_presentation;
// No state or credentials are stored in the report URL. This is a read-only snapshot.
function reportHtml(record, generatedAt = Date.now()) {
  const {state, path} = replay(record);
  const market = MARKETS[record.market];
  const profile = market.profiles[state.profile];
  const complete = path.length === ROUNDS.length;
  const outcome = complete ? OUTCOMES[path.at(-1).choice] : null;
  const paragraph = value => '<p class="written">' + esc(value) + '</p>';
  const field = (label, value) => value ? '<div class="note"><h3>' + esc(label) + '</h3>' + paragraph(value) + '</div>' : '';
  const stamp = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {timeZone: 'Europe/Moscow', dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short'}).format(generatedAt);
  const journal = path.map(event => '<article class="decision"><header><p class="eyebrow">' + esc(event.round) +
    (event.method === 'default' ? ' · Default decision' : '') + '</p><h2>' + esc(event.label) + '</h2>' +
    '<p>' + event.cost + ' credits spent · ' + event.credits + ' credits remaining</p></header>' +
    field('Evidence / assumption', event.evidence) + field('Trade-off', event.tradeoff) + field('Simulated result', event.result) +
    WORKSHEET[event.round].map(([key, label]) => field(label, record.notes[event.round + '.' + key])).join('') + '</article>').join('');
  return `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Revolut — Team ${esc(record.team)} · ${esc(market.name)} · Board report</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#f5efe3;color:#192b3c;font:20px/1.55 system-ui,sans-serif}main{max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:40px 32px 80px}h1,h2,h3,p{margin:0 0 16px}h1{font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,54px);line-height:1.12}h2{font-size:28px;line-height:1.25}h3{font-size:19px;margin-bottom:6px}.eyebrow{font-size:14px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}.muted{color:#52606b;font-size:16px}.toolbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:20px 32px 0}.toolbar button,.toolbar a{padding:12px 18px;border:1px solid #192b3c;background:#fffaf0;color:inherit;font:inherit;font-size:16px;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;border-radius:4px}.toolbar button:focus-visible,.toolbar a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #c84a32;outline-offset:3px}.metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:28px 0}.metric{padding:18px;background:#fffaf0;border:1px solid #c9c3b8}.metric strong{display:block;font-size:32px}.metric span{font-size:16px}.section,.decision{padding:28px 0;border-top:2px solid #192b3c}.decision header{margin-bottom:22px}.note{margin-bottom:18px}.written{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}a{color:#154c82}footer{border-top:1px solid #c9c3b8;padding-top:24px}body:fullscreen{overflow:auto}html:fullscreen{overflow:auto}@media(max-width:600px){body{font-size:18px}main{padding:28px 18px 60px}.toolbar{padding:16px 18px 0}.metrics{gap:8px}.metric{padding:10px}.metric strong{font-size:28px}.metric span{font-size:14px}h2{font-size:25px}}@media print{body{background:#fff;color:#111;font-size:11pt;line-height:1.4}.toolbar{display:none}main{max-width:none;padding:0}h1{font-size:26pt}h2{font-size:18pt}h3{font-size:12pt}.metrics{gap:8px;margin:16px 0}.metric{padding:10px;background:#fff}.metric strong{font-size:20pt}.metric span,.muted{font-size:10pt}.section,.decision{padding:16px 0}.decision header,.note{break-inside:avoid}h1,h2,h3{break-after:avoid}p{orphans:3;widows:3}a{color:inherit}}
</style></head><body>
<nav class="toolbar" aria-label="Report controls"><button type="button" data-report-fullscreen>Full screen</button><button type="button" data-report-print>Print / Save PDF</button><a href="${esc(MARKET_DOSSIERS[record.market])}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${esc(market.name)} dossier</a></nav>
<main><header><p class="eyebrow">Revolut · One Market First · Board report</p><h1>Team ${esc(record.team)} · ${esc(market.name)}</h1><p>${esc(market.city)} · ${esc(market.currency)}</p><p class="muted">${complete ? 'Completed strategy' : 'Strategy in progress'} · ${path.length} / ${ROUNDS.length} decisions locked<br>Snapshot: ${esc(stamp)} Moscow time. Reopen the report from the game to include later changes.</p></header>
<div class="metrics"><div class="metric"><strong>${CONFIG.budget}</strong><span>Starting credits</span></div><div class="metric"><strong>${CONFIG.budget - state.credits}</strong><span>Credits spent</span></div><div class="metric"><strong>${state.credits}</strong><span>Credits remaining</span></div></div>
<section class="section"><h2>First customer</h2>${profile ? '<h3>' + esc(profile.name) + '</h3>' + paragraph(profile.journey) : '<p>Not selected yet.</p>'}</section>
<section class="section"><h2>Request to the Board</h2>${outcome ? '<h3>' + esc(outcome[0]) + '</h3>' + paragraph(outcome[1]) : '<p>Final funding decision not locked yet.</p>'}${field('Team funding rationale', record.notes['R7.board'])}${field('One-page Board Brief', record.brief)}</section>
${complete ? '<section class="section"><h2>Simulated game result</h2><p>' + Math.round(gameScore(record).total) + ' / 100</p><p class="muted">This is the simulated game result, not the expert panel’s final grade.</p></section>' : ''}
<section aria-label="Full decision journal"><h2>Decision sequence and rationale</h2>${journal || '<p>No decisions locked yet.</p>'}</section>
<footer><h2>Common hearing question</h2>${paragraph(QUESTION)}<p class="muted">Read-only report. Decisions and notes are edited in the game.</p></footer></main></body></html>`;
}

// Open synchronously in the click handler, before awaiting queued note saves, so mobile browsers allow the tab.
function openReportWindow() {
  const popup = window.open('', '_blank');
  if (!popup) throw new Error('The report tab was blocked. Allow pop-ups for this page and press Open report again.');
  popup.opener = null;
  popup.document.title = 'Preparing team report';
  popup.document.body.textContent = 'Preparing your report…';
  return popup;
}

function writeTeamReport(popup, record) {
  if (popup.closed) return;
  popup.document.open();
  popup.document.write(reportHtml(record));
  popup.document.close();
  popup.document.querySelector('[data-report-print]').addEventListener('click', () => popup.print());
  const toggle = popup.document.querySelector('[data-report-fullscreen]');
  if (!popup.document.documentElement.requestFullscreen) toggle.hidden = true;
  else {
    toggle.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      try {
        if (popup.document.fullscreenElement) await popup.document.exitFullscreen();
        else await popup.document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
      } catch { toggle.textContent = 'Use your browser’s full-screen control'; }
    });
    popup.document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => { toggle.textContent = popup.document.fullscreenElement ? 'Exit full screen' : 'Full screen'; });
  }
}
return { reportHtml, openReportWindow, writeTeamReport };
})();

window.__omfModules = Object.assign(window.__omfModules || {}, { rules: __omf_rules, progress: __omf_progress, clock: __omf_clock, storage: __omf_storage, sync: __omf_sync, presentation: __omf_presentation, report: __omf_report });
})();
</script>
